description:
Retrieve one MantisBT issue by "id", or several by "ids" (1–50). Pass exactly one of the two.

With "id": returns the issue with all fields including notes (each with view_url), attachments and relationships, unless "select" is given.
With "ids": returns { issues, requested, found, failed } — requests run in parallel (max 5 concurrent); missing or inaccessible IDs give null at their position instead of failing the call.

Use "select" to fetch only some fields, e.g. select: "notes" for just the notes or select: "attachments" for just the file attachments of an issue.

id.description: Numeric issue ID (use either id or ids)

ids.description: Several issue IDs (1–50) to fetch in one call (use either id or ids)

select.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (server-side projection, same as list_issues). Significantly reduces response size. Example: "id,summary,status,notes"

name: get_issue
title: Get Issue
